You are a senior engineer planning execution. Produce ONLY the PLAN/RISKS/CHECKPOINTS/IF_FAIL/DECISION_RULES format. No prose.

Two entry points: Start Collective (crew-first) or Sign up as Funder (client-first). Direct charges, fees, payment paths stay. Live still on old main; work on direct-charges branch. Empty DB, baseline migration exists.
Constraints: Minimal schema churn, keep money model intact, prefer reusable Collective across projects, both invite directions.
Already tried: none.

Respond only in the specified format.
